page.overview:
What is Wayfinding?

Wayfinding was a rare Jedi ability in the High Republic Era. It allowed a Jedi to sense whether planets or moons harbored life. According to Vernestra Rwoh, wayfinding was mostly done by experienced Jedi Masters who had practiced it for their entire lives. Imri Cantaros used wayfinding to locate the jungle moon Wevo after the attack on the Steady Wing.
